close_reason: Fixed: replaced identity-map match arms with matches!() membership validation, passing lowercased string through directly.
description: parse_disposition_field (crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/common/mod.rs:2587-2603) has match arms of the form 'manual-action' => 'manual-action' for all three fields — the mapped value equals the input. Since the string is already lowercased before matching, each arm is just whitelist validation with no transformation. Replace with a set-membership check (matches\! or a list) and pass the lowercased string through directly, making the intent (validate, not map) explicit.
title: test/common/mod.rs: identity-map match arms in parse_disposition_field
